title: Passage 8
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Chemistry is usually thought to be more difficult than other subjects, at least for the beginners.
sentences.cn: 化学通常被认为比其他学科更难，至少对于初学者而言是这样。

sentences.en: There are some reasons for this idea.
sentences.cn: 这种看法有几个原因。

sentences.en: For one thing, chemistry has a very specialised vocabulary.
sentences.cn: 首先，化学有一套非常专业的词汇。

sentences.en: At first, studying chemistry is like learning a new language.
sentences.cn: 一开始，学习化学就像学习一门新语言。

sentences.en: Also, some concepts of chemistry are hard to understand.
sentences.cn: 另外，化学中的一些概念很难理解。

sentences.en: However, with hard work and careful study, you can finish this subject successfully and even enjoy it.
sentences.cn: 然而，通过努力和认真学习，你可以顺利地完成这门课程，甚至乐在其中。

sentences.en: Here are some suggestions to help you develop good study habits and better understand the topics in the book.
sentences.cn: 这里有一些建议，帮助你养成良好的学习习惯，并更好地理解书中的主题。

sentences.en: Firstly, attend classes on time.
sentences.cn: 第一，按时上课。

sentences.en: Focus on what the teacher writes with chalk on the blackboard and take careful notes in class.
sentences.cn: 注意老师用粉笔写在黑板上的内容，并在课堂上认真记笔记。

sentences.en: If possible, always review the topics you learn in class.
sentences.cn: 如果可能的话，经常复习你在课堂上所学的内容。

sentences.en: Do not be afraid to ask others for help.
sentences.cn: 不要害怕向他人寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Secondly, think whether you really understand the meaning of a term.
sentences.cn: 第二，思考你是否真正理解了某个术语的含义。

sentences.en: A good way to test your understanding is to explain a concept to a classmate or someone else.
sentences.cn: 检验理解能力的一个好方法是把一个概念解释给同学或其他人听。

sentences.en: Thirdly, pay attention to things which have something to do with chemistry in life.
sentences.cn: 第三，关注生活中与化学有关的事物。

sentences.en: Do experiments in the lab actively to gain experience.
sentences.cn: 在实验室积极做实验，以积累经验。

sentences.en: Fourthly, aim to earn an award or medal in school science fairs to recognise your hard work.
sentences.cn: 第四，力争在学校科学展览会中赢得奖项或奖牌，以肯定你的努力。

sentences.en: Have candy or a cookie after finishing a challenging project.
sentences.cn: 在完成一个有挑战性的项目后，吃点糖果或饼干。

sentences.en: This can serve as a reward for yourself.
sentences.cn: 这可以作为对自己的奖励。

sentences.en: You will find that chemistry is much more than numbers, formulas, and equations.
sentences.cn: 你会发现，化学不只是一些数字、分子式和方程式。

sentences.en: It's often used in daily life just like maths and physics.
sentences.cn: 它像数学和物理一样，经常被用在日常生活中。
